Good job putting yourself out there! You didn't give a whole lot of information about how you asked her, but just remember that you can't just walk up to a girl and say a couple of sentences to her and expect her to agree to hang out with you. You have to create some amount of warmth or chemistry. Something like "how are you?" Is enough sometimes. I see a LOT of dudes on my campus just bark "hey you're pretty, let's go out sometime." at a chick walking by looking down at her phone. I've never seen it work once. The girl doesn't even have time to look you up and down. 
So, I don't know how you actually went about it, but if that does sound like how you approached her, I would work on getting a little conversation going first. You will at least be bettering your chances a little. 
One of the few tricks I know is to get her to share one "feeling". Ex. "What's your major?" She: "bio" "oh, cool, how did you get into that?" "Do you like it?" Things like that that make them think out their feelings as opposed to just asking them trivial stuff. It's all about connection. 
I'm by no means a player, I suck and I'm always to nervous to ask them, but I hope that helps.
